title: System shutdown with Multiple GPUs training
body:
### Bug description

When training [VegAnn](https://github.com/simonMadec/VegAnn) with multiple GPUs, the system (Ubuntu 22.04) crashes and shuts down without warning at the 11 epochs. In some cases, the system is unable to boot up after the shutdown. And I have to cut off the power to reboot the machine.

However, the program can continue running if I don't use the first GPU.




### How to reproduce the bug

```python
1. Remove the env command `CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1,2` in the `main.py`
2. Run VegAnn with multiple gpus.
3. The system shuts down after 11 epochs training
```

comments.author: participant5
comments.body:
I had the same problem with 4x3090 and I found that it was because there was **not enough power supply**.

My server has a 2000W power supply. I tried to set a power limit on the GPU via cmd `nvidia-smi -pl 200` (`nvidia-smi -pl <value_in_watts>`) or limit the GPU clock speed via cmd `nvidia-smi -lgc 0,1800` (`nvidia-smi -lgc minGpuClock,maxGpuClock`). 

Both methods are effective. Maybe it is the PSU issue for me.
